name.title: Name
name.description: This block's name, shown in the logs and in the web UI.

syncBoxIpAddress.title: Sync Box Address
syncBoxIpAddress.description: The Sync Box's IP address or host name on the local network. Setup fills it in.

syncBoxUniqueId.title: Sync Box ID
syncBoxUniqueId.description: The Sync Box's unique ID, which its certificate names. Setup fills it in; without it, any certificate Philips signed is accepted until the Sync Box tells it.

baseAccessory.title: Sync Accessory
baseAccessory.description: What starts and stops syncing in HomeKit.

powerSwitchAccessory.title: Power Switch
powerSwitchAccessory.description: A switch that wakes the Sync Box (passthrough) and puts it in power save.

tvAccessory.title: HDMI Inputs TV
tvAccessory.description: A television whose inputs are the four HDMI inputs. Add it in the Home app with the bridge's setup code.

modeTvAccessory.title: Modes TV
modeTvAccessory.description: A television whose inputs are the modes: video, music, game, passthrough and power save.

intensityTvAccessory.title: Intensities TV
intensityTvAccessory.description: A television whose inputs are the intensities: subtle, moderate, high and intense.

entertainmentTvAccessory.title: Entertainment Areas TV
entertainmentTvAccessory.description: A television whose inputs are the Hue Bridge's entertainment areas.

treatPassthroughAsOffForTv.title: Passthrough Turns the TVs Off
treatPassthroughAsOffForTv.description: The televisions show as off in passthrough, not only in power save.

updateIntervalInSeconds.title: Update Interval (seconds)
updateIntervalInSeconds.description: How often the Sync Box's state is read.

uuidSeed.title: Accessory ID Seed
uuidSeed.description: Added to every accessory's ID, so several Sync Boxes stay apart. Changing it makes new accessories in HomeKit.

accessoryType.title: Icon
accessoryType.description: How the Home app shows this television.

lightbulb.title: Lightbulb
lightbulb.description: A lightbulb on this television that starts and stops syncing and sets the brightness.

fr.A lightbulb on this television that star: Une ampoule sur ce téléviseur qui lance et arrête la synchronisation et règle la luminosité.
fr.A switch that wakes the Sync Box (passth: Un interrupteur qui réveille la Sync Box (transfert direct) et la met en économie d'énergie.
fr.A television whose inputs are the Hue Br: Un téléviseur dont les entrées sont les zones de divertissement du pont Hue.
fr.A television whose inputs are the four H: Un téléviseur dont les entrées sont les quatre entrées HDMI. Ajoutez-le dans l'app Maison avec le code de configuration du pont.
fr.A television whose inputs are the intens: Un téléviseur dont les entrées sont les intensités : subtile, modérée, élevée et intense.
fr.A television whose inputs are the modes:: Un téléviseur dont les entrées sont les modes : vidéo, musique, jeu, transfert direct et économie d'énergie.
fr.Added to every accessory's ID, so severa: Ajoutée à l'identifiant de chaque accessoire, pour distinguer plusieurs Sync Box. La changer crée de nouveaux accessoires dans HomeKit.
